_about: Short test scripts for comparing cloned-voice settings. Original text written for RESONATE, plus lines the app itself already says (marked source). No third-party text.

scripts.title: Conversational
scripts.text: Right, come in, sit yourself down. Kettle's on. Take a breath, there's no rush. Whatever brought you here tonight, we'll have a look at it together.

scripts.title: Tarot reading
scripts.source: app: The Magician, One-card Guidance (data.js and positionContext)
scripts.text: Guidance: The Magician. Your next step is to work consciously with focused use of the skills and resources already available. Take what resonates, and leave the rest.

scripts.title: Humour
scripts.source: original, plus Max's opening line from presenter.js
scripts.text: Good evening. Max Chasroom here, a deliberately synthetic presenter, assembled from pixels and good intentions. Mostly good intentions. The pixels were on special.

scripts.title: Scottish place names
scripts.text: Tonight's readings come from Milngavie, Kirkcaldy, Auchtermuchty, Culross, Kirkcudbright, Ecclefechan and Strathaven. And a big hello to everyone in Glasgow.

scripts.title: Numbers and positions
scripts.source: app: Seven-card V position names (app.js spreads)
scripts.text: Past, eighteen to twenty-four months. Near future, three months. Outcome, the next eighteen to twenty-four months. Your opening dice were seven and three.
